Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; the device categories and yellow centerline rules resolve to the first selected page, white lane lines to the second, double white, red and edge lines to the third, stop lines, crosswalks and the center turn lane to the fourth, obstruction and directional markings to the fifth, and railroad markings and traffic islands to the sixth.

Confidence: high across the section; every marking is described in printed text beside its diagram, and the statements restate the printed captions, not the pictures.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.
